mandatoryCriteria: Correlation IDs: Propagates valid incoming x-request-id or generates safe UUID; attached on all success and error responses
Server-Timing: Measures handler duration and attaches Server-Timing: app;dur=<ms> header
Safe error masking: Internal errors masked without leaking database credentials, connection strings, or SQL internals
Body size limits: Rejects bodies exceeding 1 MiB with HTTP 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE
Request timeouts: Aborts requests exceeding deadline with HTTP 504 DEADLINE_EXCEEDED
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Correlation middleware, Server-Timing, 413 payload limits, deadline timeouts, and safe error masking. Out-of-scope: Third-party OpenTelemetry exporters.
